name: vvake
description: Lock Claude until you move: after a long stretch at the desk (90 min by default), prompts wait until you've moved 10 minutes. Escapes with a price: urgent: or /vvake:urgent postpones (3 a day, +10% moving each), /vvake:skip (2 a week), /vvake:unlock (last resort, always works). Your phone and watch can do the same.
